title: calceolaria ascendens subsp. glandulifera
intro: Calceolaria ascendens subsp. glandulifera, commonly known as the Pink Slipper Orchid, is a plant species within the Calceolaria genus, characterized by its unique slipper-shaped flowers. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating wounds, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Calceolaria ascendens subsp. glandulifera include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Additionally, the plant has been found to exhibit sedative and antiseptic effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
